messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout started: release=v2.4.1, pipeline=service-api, change_window=2026-03-20T22:00Z..23:30Z. Regions: us-east-1 -> canary(10%), eu-west-1 -> canary(10%), ap-southeast-1 -> hold.
maya: tagging this thread for capacity checks. Is Dedicated capacity already reserved for eu?
oliver: yes, Dedicated pools reserved: us-east-1: 48 GPUs, eu-west-1: 24 GPUs (2 pools), ap-southeast-1: 0 (we're using hosted burst). Numbers from capacity dashboard: peak expected tokens/s ~ 120k across US.
jena: runbook reminder: if error-rate > 3% during canary -> pause and roll back region. Also pin clients on Dedicated to v2.4.0 until after canary clears.
sam: note: a handful of enterprise tenants (acct: AcmeCorp, Finly) are pinned to v2.3.x by contract. We'll need to avoid hitting their dedicated pools with v2.4.1.
liam: rolling command (dry-run):
```
/deploy release v2.4.1 --regions us-east-1,eu-west-1 --stages 10,50,100 --hold ap-southeast-1 --dry-run
```
maya: OLIVER can you confirm warmup cache setting for eu canary? We need prefix-KV preload for top-50 prompts.
oliver: done. Preload job kicked at 2026-03-20T21:30Z. KV hit expected 85% first-pass.
deploy-bot: canary(us-east-1 10%) -> success (latency p95 82ms, error-rate 0.7%). canary(eu-west-1 10%) -> error-rate spike 4.1% (503s from model runtime).
jena: pausing eu rollout. plan: rollback eu canary to v2.4.0, investigate runtime spikes (GPU kernel fallback?). Maya note: do not touch us region.
sam: agreed. execute region-only rollback: 
```
/deploy rollback service-api --region eu-west-1 --to v2.4.0 --reason "canary error-rate spike"
```
ops-oncall: FYI I'll open a paged incident if error-rate stays >3% for next 10m. Alert thresholds already set.
oliver: grabbing logs from runtime: attaching snippet: 
```
[2026-03-20T22:05:12Z] model-runtime: kernel-fallback triggered for layer 7, device GPU-2, latency spike 340ms
[2026-03-20T22:05:12Z] batch-coordinator: batch-size limited due to memory pressure
```
liam: rollback command issued, deploy-bot?
deploy-bot: rollback(eu-west-1) -> in_progress. target=v2.4.0. ETA 2m.
deploy-bot: rollback(eu-west-1) -> complete. status=success. eu-west-1 now on v2.4.0.
maya: status: us canary stable, eu rolled back. apac still on hold per change window. Next steps: 1) schedule post-mortem with eng-runtime + infra to root-cause kernel fallback, 2) run extended capacity test in staging for eu to reproduce, 3) hold apac until fix validated.
sam: I'll update release notes: add known issue section: "EU canary: transient kernel fallback causing spikes; rolled back to v2.4.0" and notify on-call customers.
jenA (typo): sorry interject - customers with Dedicated pinned versions will remain pinned; confirm we didn't unpin anyone.
maya: confirmed, no pins changed.
ops-oncall: closing loop: no customer-facing incident needed yet, will escalate if we see repeat. :white_check_mark:
liam: propose follow-up rollout tomorrow 03/21 02:00Z targeting eu after patch. I'll coordinate capacity and warmup.
maya: thanks everyone. I'll file the rollout ticket and link the post-mortem once created. :thumbsup:
